final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) AS ast_alt_avg, AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) AS aptt_pt_avg FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(ast_alt_avg) AS avg_of_status_ast_alt_avgs, AVG(aptt_pt_avg) AS avg_of_status_aptt_pt_avgs FROM status_avgs
